千瓦时（度）是电能的大单位，1 度电等于 $3.6\\times10^6$ 焦。: The kilowatt-hour (the "unit" on the electricity bill) is a large unit of electrical energy; 1 kilowatt-hour equals $3.6\times10^6$ J.
我国家庭电路的电压是 220 伏；不高于 36 伏的电压对人体才是安全的。: The voltage of household circuits in China is 220 V; only a voltage of no more than 36 V is safe for the human body.
台灯接 220 伏插座工作；该电压远高于 36 伏，所以不能用手触摸插孔: A desk lamp works when plugged into a 220 V socket; this voltage is far above 36 V, so the socket holes must not be touched with a hand.
2 个氢分子和 1 个氧分子点燃后生成 2 个水分子；系数 2、1、2 使两边原: 2 hydrogen molecules and 1 oxygen molecule form 2 water molecules when ignited; the coefficients 2, 1, 2 make the number of atoms equal on both sides.
氢气安静燃烧，火焰淡蓝色，只生成水，是清洁能源；点燃前要验纯。: Hydrogen burns quietly with a pale blue flame and produces only water, so it is a clean energy source; it must be tested for purity before it is ignited.
碳在氧气充足时燃烧，生成二氧化碳；1 个碳原子与 1 个氧分子反应。: When carbon burns with plenty of oxygen, it forms carbon dioxide; 1 carbon atom reacts with 1 oxygen molecule.
木炭在氧气中发白光、放热，生成能使澄清石灰水变浑浊的气体。: Charcoal burns in oxygen with a white light and gives off heat, forming a gas that turns clear limewater cloudy.
碳在氧气不足时燃烧，生成一氧化碳；2 个碳原子配 1 个氧分子。: When carbon burns with too little oxygen, it forms carbon monoxide; 2 carbon atoms go with 1 oxygen molecule.
煤炉通风不好时会生成有毒的一氧化碳，容易引起煤气中毒。: When a coal stove is badly ventilated, poisonous carbon monoxide forms, which easily causes gas poisoning.
2 个一氧化碳分子和 1 个氧分子点燃，生成 2 个二氧化碳分子。: 2 carbon monoxide molecules and 1 oxygen molecule form 2 carbon dioxide molecules when ignited.
一氧化碳燃烧发出蓝色火焰，放热，可作燃料；但它本身有毒。: Carbon monoxide burns with a blue flame and gives off heat; it can be used as a fuel, but it is itself poisonous.
硫和氧气点燃，生成二氧化硫；1 个硫原子配 1 个氧分子。: Sulfur and oxygen form sulfur dioxide when ignited; 1 sulfur atom goes with 1 oxygen molecule.
硫在氧气中发出蓝紫色火焰，生成有刺激性气味的气体，会污染空气。: Sulfur burns in oxygen with a bright blue-purple flame, forming a gas with a pungent smell that pollutes the air.
4 个磷原子和 5 个氧分子点燃，生成 2 个五氧化二磷分子（$P_2O_5$）: 4 phosphorus atoms and 5 oxygen molecules form 2 molecules of diphosphorus pentoxide ($P_2O_5$) when ignited.
红磷燃烧产生大量白烟，常用来测定空气中氧气的含量。: Red phosphorus burns with a lot of white smoke and is often used to measure the oxygen content of air.
3 个铁原子和 2 个氧分子点燃，生成四氧化三铁（$Fe_3O_4$，黑色固体）: 3 iron atoms and 2 oxygen molecules form triiron tetroxide ($Fe_3O_4$, a black solid) when ignited.
铁丝在氧气中火星四射，生成黑色固体；集气瓶底要放少量水或细沙。: Iron wire burns in oxygen with showers of sparks, forming a black solid; a little water or fine sand must be put at the bottom of the gas jar.
2 个镁原子和 1 个氧分子点燃，生成 2 个氧化镁。: 2 magnesium atoms and 1 oxygen molecule form 2 units of magnesium oxide when ignited.
镁条燃烧发出耀眼的白光，生成白色固体，可用来做照明弹和烟花。: A strip of magnesium burns with a dazzling white light, forming a white solid; it is used in flares and fireworks.
铜在空气中加热，和氧气反应生成氧化铜；$\\triangle$ 表示加热。: Copper heated in air reacts with oxygen to form copper(II) oxide; $\triangle$ means heating.
红色的铜丝加热后表面变成黑色的氧化铜。: A red copper wire turns black on the surface after heating, forming copper(II) oxide.
4 个铝原子和 3 个氧分子反应，生成氧化铝；常温下就能慢慢发生。: 4 aluminium atoms and 3 oxygen molecules react to form aluminium oxide; this happens slowly even at room temperature.
铝表面生成致密的氧化膜，保护里面的铝，所以铝制品很耐用。: A dense oxide film forms on the surface of aluminium and protects the aluminium underneath, so aluminium products are very durable.
甲烷与氧气点燃，生成二氧化碳和水；注意先配平碳、氢，最后配氧。: Methane burns with oxygen to form carbon dioxide and water; balance the carbon and the hydrogen first and the oxygen last.
甲烷是天然气的主要成分，燃烧发出淡蓝色火焰，放出大量热。: Methane is the main component of natural gas; it burns with a pale blue flame and gives off a lot of heat.
酒精（乙醇）与氧气点燃，生成二氧化碳和水；系数依次是 1、3、2、3。: Alcohol (ethanol) burns with oxygen to form carbon dioxide and water; the coefficients are, in order, 1, 3, 2, 3.
酒精灯燃烧；桌上的酒精着火时，用湿抹布盖灭，不能用水冲。: The burning of a spirit lamp; if alcohol spilled on a table catches fire, smother it with a damp cloth and do not use water.
加热高锰酸钾，分解出锰酸钾、二氧化锰和氧气；$\\uparrow$ 表示气体逸出: Heating potassium permanganate decomposes it into potassium manganate, manganese dioxide and oxygen; $\uparrow$ means that a gas escapes.
加热紫黑色固体制氧气；试管口要放一团棉花，防止粉末进入导管。: Heat a purple-black solid to prepare oxygen; a wad of cotton must be placed at the mouth of the test tube to keep powder out of the delivery tube.
氯酸钾在二氧化锰催化、加热下分解，生成氯化钾和氧气。: Potassium chlorate decomposes on heating, with manganese dioxide as catalyst, into potassium chloride and oxygen.
二氧化锰是催化剂，反应前后质量和化学性质不变，只加快反应。: Manganese dioxide is a catalyst: its mass and chemical properties are unchanged before and after the reaction, and it only speeds the reaction up.
过氧化氢在二氧化锰催化下分解，生成水和氧气，不需要加热。: Hydrogen peroxide decomposes into water and oxygen with manganese dioxide as catalyst; no heating is needed.
双氧水加入二氧化锰，立即冒出大量气泡，常温下就能制氧气。: When manganese dioxide is added to hydrogen peroxide solution, many bubbles appear at once; oxygen can be prepared at room temperature.
水通电分解成氢气和氧气；2 个水分子分解得 2 个氢分子和 1 个氧分子。: Water decomposes into hydrogen and oxygen when an electric current is passed through it; 2 water molecules give 2 hydrogen molecules and 1 oxygen molecule.
电解水时，负极得氢气、正极得氧气，体积比约为 2：1。: In the electrolysis of water, hydrogen is obtained at the negative electrode and oxygen at the positive electrode, in a volume ratio of about 2:1.
碳酸钙和稀盐酸反应，生成氯化钙、水和二氧化碳气体。: Calcium carbonate reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to form calcium chloride, water and carbon dioxide gas.
大理石加稀盐酸冒气泡，二氧化碳用向上排空气法收集。: Marble bubbles when dilute hydrochloric acid is added; the carbon dioxide is collected by upward displacement of air.
石灰石（主要成分碳酸钙）高温加热，分解成氧化钙（生石灰）和二氧化碳。: Limestone (mainly calcium carbonate) heated to a high temperature decomposes into calcium oxide (quicklime) and carbon dioxide.
工业上用煅烧石灰石的方法制取生石灰。: In industry, quicklime is made by calcining limestone.
碳酸氢钠（小苏打）受热分解，生成碳酸钠、水和二氧化碳。: Sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) decomposes on heating into sodium carbonate, water and carbon dioxide.
做馒头、蛋糕时受热产生二氧化碳，使面团变得松软。: When steamed buns and cakes are heated, carbon dioxide is produced and makes the dough soft and fluffy.
锌和稀硫酸反应，生成硫酸锌和氢气；这是锌排在氢前面的结果。: Zinc reacts with dilute sulfuric acid to form zinc sulfate and hydrogen; this results from zinc being above hydrogen in the reactivity series.
锌粒加稀硫酸冒气泡，可用排水法收集氢气。: Granulated zinc bubbles when dilute sulfuric acid is added; the hydrogen can be collected over water.
二氧化碳与氢氧化钙（石灰水）反应，生成碳酸钙沉淀（$\\downarrow$）和: Carbon dioxide reacts with calcium hydroxide (limewater) to form a precipitate of calcium carbonate ($\downarrow$) and water.
把气体通入澄清石灰水，变浑浊，就说明是二氧化碳。: If a gas is passed into clear limewater and it turns cloudy, the gas is carbon dioxide.
二氧化碳溶于水并与水反应，生成碳酸（$H_2CO_3$）。: Carbon dioxide dissolves in water and reacts with it to form carbonic acid ($H_2CO_3$).
汽水里有碳酸；碳酸能使紫色石蕊试液变红。: Soda water contains carbonic acid; carbonic acid turns purple litmus solution red.
二氧化碳与氢氧化钠反应，生成碳酸钠和水；2 个 NaOH 对应 1 个 $CO_: Carbon dioxide reacts with sodium hydroxide to form sodium carbonate and water; 2 NaOH correspond to 1 $CO_2$.
这个反应没有明显现象，氢氧化钠溶液可用来吸收二氧化碳。: This reaction has no obvious sign; sodium hydroxide solution can be used to absorb carbon dioxide.
氧化钙（生石灰）与水化合，生成氢氧化钙（熟石灰），并放出大量热。: Calcium oxide (quicklime) combines with water to form calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) and gives off a lot of heat.
生石灰遇水放热，可用来加热食品；也常做干燥剂。: Quicklime gives off heat on contact with water and can be used to heat food; it is also often used as a desiccant.
铁与稀盐酸发生置换反应，生成氯化亚铁和氢气，铁显 +2 价。: Iron undergoes a displacement reaction with dilute hydrochloric acid, forming iron(II) chloride and hydrogen; iron shows a valence of +2.
铁钉放入稀盐酸，冒气泡，溶液慢慢变成浅绿色。: An iron nail placed in dilute hydrochloric acid bubbles, and the solution slowly turns pale green.
铁比铜活泼，能把铜从硫酸铜溶液中置换出来，生成硫酸亚铁和铜。: Iron is more reactive than copper and can displace copper from a copper(II) sulfate solution, forming iron(II) sulfate and copper.
铁钉放进蓝色硫酸铜溶液，钉子表面变红，溶液变浅绿。: When an iron nail is put into blue copper(II) sulfate solution, the surface of the nail turns red and the solution turns pale green.
铜比银活泼，能把银从硝酸银溶液中置换出来，生成硝酸铜和银。: Copper is more reactive than silver and can displace silver from a silver nitrate solution, forming copper(II) nitrate and silver.
铜丝放入硝酸银溶液，表面长出银白色固体，溶液变蓝。: When a copper wire is put into silver nitrate solution, a silvery-white solid grows on its surface and the solution turns blue.
盐酸与氢氧化钠发生中和反应，生成氯化钠（食盐）和水。: Hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide undergo a neutralisation reaction, forming sodium chloride (table salt) and water.
氢氧化钠溶液中滴入酚酞呈红色；滴加盐酸至红色恰好褪去，说明恰好完全反应。: Phenolphthalein turns red in sodium hydroxide solution; hydrochloric acid is added until the red colour just disappears, which shows that the reaction is exactly complete.
硫酸与氢氧化钠中和，生成硫酸钠和水；2 个 NaOH 对应 1 个 $H_2SO: Sulfuric acid and sodium hydroxide neutralise each other, forming sodium sulfate and water; 2 NaOH correspond to 1 $H_2SO_4$.
酸和碱反应生成盐和水，这类反应叫中和反应。: An acid and a base react to form a salt and water; this kind of reaction is called a neutralisation reaction.
盐酸与氢氧化钙（熟石灰）中和，生成氯化钙和水。: Hydrochloric acid and calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) neutralise each other, forming calcium chloride and water.
农业上用熟石灰中和酸性土壤，工厂也用它处理酸性废水。: In agriculture slaked lime is used to neutralise acidic soil, and factories also use it to treat acidic waste water.
盐酸与硝酸银反应，生成不溶于水的白色氯化银沉淀和硝酸。: Hydrochloric acid reacts with silver nitrate to form a white precipitate of silver chloride, which is insoluble in water, and nitric acid.
滴入硝酸银产生白色沉淀，可检验溶液中有氯离子。: A white precipitate forms when silver nitrate is added; this can be used to test for chloride ions in a solution.
碳酸钠与盐酸反应，生成氯化钠、水和二氧化碳；注意 HCl 和 NaCl 前都是: Sodium carbonate reacts with hydrochloric acid to form sodium chloride, water and carbon dioxide; note that the coefficients in front of HCl and NaCl are both 2.
碳酸钠加盐酸剧烈冒气泡；碳酸盐遇酸放出二氧化碳。: Sodium carbonate bubbles violently when hydrochloric acid is added; carbonates give off carbon dioxide with acids.
加热时氢气夺走氧化铜中的氧，生成铜和水，说明氢气有还原性。: When heated, hydrogen takes the oxygen from copper(II) oxide, forming copper and water, which shows that hydrogen is a reducing agent.
黑色氧化铜变成红色的铜，试管口有水珠；先通氢气再加热。: Black copper(II) oxide turns into red copper and water droplets appear at the mouth of the test tube; pass hydrogen first and heat afterwards.
高温下一氧化碳夺走氧化铁中的氧，把铁还原出来，并生成二氧化碳。: At a high temperature carbon monoxide takes the oxygen from iron(III) oxide, reducing it to iron and forming carbon dioxide.
高炉炼铁原理：红棕色粉末变黑；尾气有毒，要点燃或收集。: The principle of ironmaking in a blast furnace: the red-brown powder turns black; the exhaust gas is poisonous and must be burned or collected.
高温下碳夺走氧化铜中的氧，生成铜和二氧化碳，说明碳有还原性。: At a high temperature carbon takes the oxygen from copper(II) oxide, forming copper and carbon dioxide, which shows that carbon is a reducing agent.
黑色粉末变红，同时产生的气体使澄清石灰水变浑浊。: The black powder turns red, and at the same time the gas produced turns clear limewater cloudy.
越靠左的金属越活泼；前面的金属能把后面的金属从盐溶液中置换出来；排在 H 前的能: The further left a metal is, the more reactive it is; a metal earlier in the series can displace a later metal from its salt solution; metals before H react with dilute acids to give off hydrogen.
铁排在铜前面，所以铁能把硫酸铜溶液里的铜置换出来。: Iron is before copper in the series, so iron can displace the copper in a copper(II) sulfate solution.
化合价表示一种元素的原子与其他元素的原子相互化合时的数目关系；在化合物里，各元素: The valence expresses the numerical relationship in which the atoms of an element combine with the atoms of other elements; in a compound, the algebraic sum of the valences of all the elements is 0.
这些元素的常见化合价；铁有 +2 和 +3 两种，氧通常是 $-2$ 价。: The common valences of these elements; iron has the two valences +2 and +3, and oxygen is usually $-2$.
原子团作为整体参加反应，带有固定的化合价，写化学式时要看它的价数。: An atomic group takes part in reactions as a whole and has a fixed valence; when writing a formula, look at its valence.
溶质质量分数表示溶液里溶质占多少；溶液质量 = 溶质质量 + 溶剂质量。: The mass fraction of solute shows how much of the solution is solute; mass of solution = mass of solute + mass of solvent.
5 克盐溶于 45 克水：$\\frac{5}{5+45}\\times100\: 5 g of salt dissolved in 45 g of water: $\frac{5}{5+45}\times100\%=10\%$
pH 表示溶液酸碱性：小于 7 是酸性，等于 7 是中性，大于 7 是碱性。: The pH shows the acidity or basicity of a solution: below 7 it is acidic, equal to 7 it is neutral, above 7 it is basic.
柠檬汁 pH 约为 2，是酸性；肥皂水 pH 大于 7，是碱性。: Lemon juice has a pH of about 2 and is acidic; soapy water has a pH above 7 and is basic.
化学反应前后，参加反应的各物质总质量，等于生成的各物质总质量。: Before and after a chemical reaction, the total mass of the substances that react equals the total mass of the substances formed.
12 克碳与 32 克氧气恰好反应：生成二氧化碳 $12+32=44$ 克: 12 g of carbon react exactly with 32 g of oxygen: $12+32=44$ g of carbon dioxide is formed
相对分子质量等于分子中各原子的相对原子质量总和，没有单位。: The relative molecular mass equals the sum of the relative atomic masses of all the atoms in the molecule; it has no unit.
生物能吃东西、长大、繁殖后代: Living things eat, grow and reproduce
生物能对外界刺激作出反应: Living things respond to stimuli from the outside
生物需要空气、水和食物: Living things need air, water and food
生物都会死亡，石头、水、空气不是生物: All living things die; stones, water and air are not living things
植物虽然不会跑，但也是生物: Plants cannot run, but they are living things too

警告标志：黄色三角形，提醒前方有危险，如注意行人、注意儿童、注意信号灯: Warning signs: yellow triangle, warning of danger ahead, e.g. pedestrians, children, traffic lights
指示标志：蓝色圆形（或方形），表示应当这样走，如直行、向右转弯、步行: Information signs: blue circle (or square), meaning "go this way", e.g. straight on, turn right, pedestrians
看到禁止标志不做，看到警告标志减速小心，看到指示标志按规定走: At a prohibition sign, do not do it; at a warning sign, slow down and take care; at an information sign, follow the rule
学校、居民区附近常有“注意儿童”标志，车辆要减速，行人也要小心: Near schools and residential areas there are often "Children" signs: vehicles must slow down and pedestrians must also take care
标志上的数字，如“30”，表示限速每小时30千米: A number on a sign, such as "30", means a speed limit of 30 kilometres per hour
认识常见交通标志，是安全出行的第一步: Knowing common traffic signs is the first step to travelling safely
红圈是禁止，黄三角是警告，蓝圆是指示: Red circle means prohibition, yellow triangle means warning, blue circle means information
看到交通标志要按标志的意思行动: When you see a traffic sign, act according to its meaning
红圈禁、黄角警、蓝圆指: Red circle forbids, yellow angle warns, blue circle directs (红圈禁、黄角警、蓝圆指)
骑车与乘车安全: Safety when cycling and riding in vehicles
按规定，驾驶自行车须年满12周岁，驾驶电动自行车须年满16周岁；不满年龄不上路骑: By regulation, one must be 12 to ride a bicycle and 16 to ride an electric bicycle; under that age, do not ride on the road
骑自行车要靠右，走非机动车道，不逆行、不并排追逐、不撒手、不带人: When cycling, keep to the right in the non-motor-vehicle lane; do not go against traffic, ride side by side chasing each other, take your hands off the handlebars or carry a passenger
骑行时戴头盔更安全；骑电动自行车要戴头盔（许多地方规定必须戴）: Wearing a helmet while cycling is safer; wear one on an electric bicycle (many places require it)
乘小汽车要系好安全带，坐在后排，不把头和手伸出窗外: In a car, fasten your seat belt, sit in the back and do not put your head or hands out of the window
儿童要使用与身高体重相符的儿童安全座椅，不坐副驾驶位: Children should use a child safety seat suited to their height and weight and should not sit in the front passenger seat
乘公交车要排队，车停稳后再上下，不在车内奔跑，抓好扶手: On a bus, queue up, get on and off only after it has stopped fully, do not run inside and hold the handrail
不在车辆行驶时开门；下车前先看后方有没有来车、电动车: Do not open a door while the vehicle is moving; before getting out, check behind for cars and e-bikes
乘车要系好安全带: Fasten your seat belt in a vehicle
骑电动自行车要戴头盔: Wear a helmet on an electric bicycle
不满12周岁不骑自行车上路: Under 12, do not ride a bicycle on the road
骑车靠右戴头盔，乘车系好安全带: Keep right and wear a helmet when cycling; fasten your seat belt in a car
消防安全：火警与逃生: Fire safety: fire alarm and escape
发现火情，立即拨打火警电话119，说清地址、什么东西着火、有没有人被困: If you find a fire, call the fire number 119 at once and say the address, what is burning and whether anyone is trapped
火很小时可以用灭火器；火大了立刻逃生，不要贪恋财物: A very small fire can be put out with an extinguisher; if it is large, escape at once and do not go back for belongings
逃生时用湿毛巾捂住口鼻，弯腰、低姿，贴近地面撤离，因为浓烟往上飘: When escaping, cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel and leave bending low, close to the ground, because thick smoke rises
不乘电梯，走安全通道和楼梯；楼道里烟太浓时回到房间，关紧门，用湿布堵门缝，到窗边: Do not use the lift; take the safety exit and stairs; if the smoke in the corridor is too thick, go back into a room, close the door tightly, block the gap with a wet cloth and call for help at the window
身上着火不要乱跑，就地打滚把火压灭: If your clothes catch fire, do not run; roll on the ground to put it out
不玩火，不玩打火机、鞭炮；发现别的小朋友玩火要劝阻并告诉大人: Do not play with fire, lighters or firecrackers; if other children play with fire, stop them and tell an adult
知道家里和学校的安全出口在哪里，参加逃生演练: Know where the safety exits are at home and at school, and take part in evacuation drills
逃生要用湿毛巾捂口鼻、弯腰低姿: When escaping, cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel and stay low
发生火灾不乘电梯: In a fire, do not use the lift
湿巾捂口鼻，低姿向外跑，电梯不要坐: Wet cloth over nose and mouth, run out low, no lift
常见的是手提式干粉灭火器，用于扑救初起的小火；火势已大要立即撤离: The common type is the portable dry-powder extinguisher, used on small fires just starting; if the fire is already large, leave at once
使用口诀：提、拔、握、压——提起灭火器，拔掉保险销，握住喷管，压下手柄: Mnemonic: lift, pull, hold, press - lift the extinguisher, pull out the safety pin, hold the nozzle, press the handle (提、拔、握、压)
站在上风口，对准火焰根部左右扫射，不对着火苗上方喷: Stand upwind and sweep the base of the flames from side to side; do not spray above the flames
油锅起火：关火后盖上锅盖，不能用水浇: Oil pan fire: turn off the heat and cover with a lid; never pour water on it
电器着火：先切断电源，再灭火；未断电时不要用水: Electrical fire: cut off the power first, then extinguish; do not use water while the power is on
使用前看清压力表指针在绿色区域，灭火器放在明显、方便取用的地方: Before use, check that the pressure gauge needle is in the green zone; keep the extinguisher in a visible, easy-to-reach place
灭火器用完后要重新检查或更换，不能放回原处当作好的: After use, an extinguisher must be rechecked or replaced; do not put it back in place as if it were good
使用灭火器：拔掉保险销，握住喷管，压下手柄: Using an extinguisher: pull out the safety pin, hold the nozzle, press the handle
对准火焰根部扫射: Aim at the base of the flames and sweep
油锅起火用锅盖盖灭，不能浇水: For an oil pan fire, smother it with the lid; never pour water
拔销、握管、压把，瞄准火根扫: Pull the pin, hold the hose, press the handle, aim at the base and sweep (拔销、握管、压把，瞄准火根扫)
不用湿手、湿布碰插头、插座和开关: Do not touch plugs, sockets or switches with wet hands or a wet cloth
不把手指、铁丝、小刀插进插座孔；家里的插座可以装保护盖: Do not push fingers, wire or knives into socket holes; sockets at home can be fitted with protective covers
不拉扯电线，拔插头时抓住插头，不抓电线: Do not pull on cables; when unplugging, hold the plug, not the cable
一个插座上不同时接很多大功率电器，防止过热起火: Do not connect many high-power appliances to one socket at the same time, to prevent overheating and fire
电线破皮、插头发热、冒火花，要立刻告诉大人，不自己修: If a cable is damaged, a plug is hot or sparks appear, tell an adult at once and do not repair it yourself
不在高压线、变压器附近放风筝、玩耍；看到“高压危险”标志要远离: Do not fly kites or play near high-voltage lines or transformers; keep away when you see a "High voltage - danger" sign
有人触电，不要直接用手去拉，先让大人切断电源，再拨打120: If someone is electrocuted, do not pull them with your bare hands; have an adult cut the power first, then call 120
湿手不碰电器和插座: Do not touch appliances or sockets with wet hands
有人触电先切断电源，不直接去拉: If someone is electrocuted, cut the power first and do not pull them directly
电线破损要告诉大人，不自己修: Tell an adult about damaged cables; do not repair them yourself
湿手不碰电，插孔不插东西: No wet hands near electricity; nothing into socket holes
闻到燃气味（臭鸡蛋味），不要开关电灯、电器，不要打电话，不要点火: If you smell gas (like rotten eggs), do not switch lights or appliances on or off, do not use the phone and do not light a flame
立即关闭燃气阀门，打开门窗通风，到室外再拨打燃气公司的抢修电话: Close the gas valve at once, open doors and windows for ventilation, and call the gas company's emergency repair number from outside
必要时拨打119，同时提醒邻居离开: If necessary call 119, and warn the neighbours to leave
用完燃气要关好阀门，煮东西时人不能离开: After using gas, close the valve; do not leave the room while cooking
燃气灶旁不堆放纸张、塑料等易燃物: Do not pile paper, plastic or other flammable items next to the gas cooker
热水器要安装在通风处，洗澡时保持通风，防止一氧化碳中毒: Water heaters must be installed in a ventilated place, and the room kept ventilated when showering, to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning
头晕、恶心、乏力时要立刻到空气新鲜的地方，并告诉大人: If you feel dizzy, sick or weak, go at once to a place with fresh air and tell an adult
闻到燃气味：不开关电器，不点火: If you smell gas: no switching appliances, no flames
关阀门，开窗通风，到室外求助: Close the valve, open windows, get help outside
用燃气热水器要通风: Ventilate when using a gas water heater
关阀、开窗、不点火，出去再打电话: Close the valve, open windows, no flames; phone only once outside
不私自下水游泳: Do not go into the water to swim without permission
不擅自与同学结伴游泳: Do not go swimming with classmates on your own
不在无家长或教师带领时游泳: Do not swim without a parent or teacher leading
不到无安全设施、无救援人员的水域游泳: Do not swim in waters without safety facilities or rescue staff
不到不熟悉的水域游泳: Do not swim in waters you do not know
不熟悉水性的学生不擅自下水施救: Students who cannot swim well must not go into the water to rescue someone
看到有人落水，大声呼喊成年人，拨打120和110，可以扔救生圈、木板、长竿，自己: If you see someone fall into the water, shout loudly for adults, call 120 and 110, and throw a lifebuoy, board or long pole; do not go in yourself
防溺水六不：不私自下水、不结伴游泳、不无人带领游泳、不去无安全设施的水域、不去不: The six don'ts: no swimming without permission, no swimming with friends alone, no swimming without a leader, no waters without safety facilities, no unfamiliar waters, no rescue attempts by entering the water
看到有人落水，大声呼救，不盲目下水: If you see someone fall in, call loudly for help; do not jump in blindly
六个“不”记牢，水边安全才可靠: Remember the six "don'ts" and the waterside will be safe
地震来了怎么办: What to do in an earthquake
在教室里：伏地（蹲下）、遮挡（躲在课桌旁，抓牢桌腿，保护头颈）、避让（远离窗户、: In the classroom: drop (crouch), cover (take shelter beside the desk, hold the desk legs, protect head and neck), keep clear (stay away from windows, lamps and outer walls)
在家里：躲在坚固的桌子下、承重墙的墙角或开间小的卫生间，不躲在窗边和阳台: At home: shelter under a sturdy table, in the corner of a load-bearing wall or in a small bathroom; not by windows or on balconies
震动停止后，有秩序地撤离到空旷地方，不乘电梯，不拥挤: When the shaking stops, evacuate in an orderly way to open ground; do not use the lift and do not crowd
在楼房低层，震动一停可以尽快撤到室外；不要慌张跳楼: On a low floor, you may get outside as soon as the shaking stops; do not panic and jump from a window
在户外：远离高楼、广告牌、电线杆，蹲在空旷处: Outdoors: keep away from tall buildings, billboards and utility poles, and crouch in an open area
在公共场所：不拥向出口，就地蹲下保护头部: In public places: do not rush toward the exits; crouch where you are and protect your head
地震后还可能有余震，不要马上回到楼里；听从老师和大人的安排: Aftershocks may follow; do not go back into the building at once; follow the arrangements of teachers and adults
地震时不乘电梯，不跳楼: In an earthquake, do not use the lift and do not jump from windows
撤离要有序，到空旷处: Evacuate in order, to open ground
先伏地，再遮挡，后避让；电梯不要坐: First drop, then cover, then keep clear; no lift
台风、暴雨、寒潮的预警颜色分四级：蓝色、黄色、橙色、红色: Typhoon, rainstorm and cold-wave warnings have four levels: blue, yellow, orange, red
颜色越深，危险越大：蓝色（一般）、黄色（较重）、橙色（严重）、红色（特别严重）: The darker the colour, the greater the danger: blue (general), yellow (serious), orange (severe), red (extremely severe)
高温、雷电的预警分黄色、橙色、红色三级: Heat and lightning warnings have three levels: yellow, orange, red
收到橙色、红色预警时，尽量待在室内，不外出: When an orange or red warning is received, stay indoors as far as possible and do not go out
可以通过天气预报、手机预警短信和广播了解预警: You can learn about warnings from the weather forecast, mobile phone alert messages and the radio
学校和社区会根据预警发出通知，如停课、停止户外活动: Schools and communities issue notices according to warnings, such as class suspension or halting outdoor activities
听从老师和家长的安排，不自己到危险地方观看: Follow the arrangements of teachers and parents; do not go to dangerous places to watch
预警颜色：蓝、黄、橙、红，越深越危险: Warning colours: blue, yellow, orange, red; the darker, the more dangerous
收到橙色、红色预警要尽量待在室内: When an orange or red warning is received, stay indoors as far as possible
蓝黄橙红，一级比一级严重: Blue, yellow, orange, red: each level more serious than the last
上下楼梯靠右走，慢步轻声，不推挤，不在楼梯上追跑、打闹、嬉戏: On stairs keep right, walk slowly and quietly, do not push, chase, fool around or play
课间在教室、走廊轻声活动，不在走廊里奔跑，不坐在窗台上，不探出窗外: At break, be quiet in classrooms and corridors; do not run in corridors, sit on window sills or lean out of windows
体育课先做准备活动，听从老师的指挥，不做没学过的危险动作: In sports lessons, warm up first, follow the teacher's instructions and do not attempt dangerous moves you have not learned
不带刀具、打火机等危险物品到学校，不把铅笔、剪刀对着别人: Do not bring knives, lighters or other dangerous items to school; do not point pencils or scissors at others
放学按时回家，不在校外逗留，不跟陌生人走: Go home on time after school, do not linger outside school and do not go with strangers
受伤或身体不舒服，马上告诉老师: If you are hurt or feel unwell, tell a teacher at once
发生火灾、地震等紧急情况，听从老师指挥，有序撤离: In a fire, earthquake or other emergency, follow the teacher's instructions and evacuate in an orderly way
上下楼梯靠右走，不推挤: Keep right on stairs; do not push
课间不在走廊追跑，不探出窗外: At break, do not chase in corridors or lean out of windows
受伤或不舒服马上告诉老师: If hurt or unwell, tell a teacher at once
楼梯靠右慢步走，课间活动守规矩: Keep right and walk slowly on stairs; follow the rules at break
吃东西前先洗手；水果、蔬菜要洗干净: Wash your hands before eating; wash fruit and vegetables clean
看清包装上的生产日期和保质期，过期的东西不吃，包装破损、胀袋的不吃: Check the production date and shelf life on the packaging; do not eat expired food or food with damaged or swollen packaging
生的和熟的食物分开放，菜刀和砧板生熟分开；肉、蛋、海鲜要煮熟煮透: Keep raw and cooked food apart, and use separate knives and chopping boards; cook meat, eggs and seafood thoroughly
不吃来路不明的食物，不捡地上的东西吃，不吃陌生人给的东西: Do not eat food of unknown origin, food picked up from the ground or food given by strangers
不吃野生蘑菇和不认识的野果、野菜: Do not eat wild mushrooms or wild fruit and vegetables you do not recognise
不喝生水；少吃油炸食品和含糖饮料，不暴饮暴食: Do not drink untreated water; eat less fried food and sugary drinks and do not overeat
如果吃东西后呕吐、腹泻、肚子疼，告诉大人；有过敏史的食物一口也不吃: If you vomit, have diarrhoea or stomach ache after eating, tell an adult; never eat even a bite of a food you are allergic to
看清保质期，过期食品不吃: Check the shelf life; do not eat expired food
生熟分开，肉蛋要煮熟: Keep raw and cooked apart; cook meat and eggs through
不吃不认识的野果、野蘑菇，不捡地上的东西吃: Do not eat unknown wild fruit or wild mushrooms or food picked up from the ground
先洗手，看日期，生熟分，野味不吃: Wash hands first, check dates, separate raw and cooked, no wild game (先洗手，看日期，生熟分，野味不吃)
防走失与不跟陌生人走: Preventing getting lost, and not going with strangers
记住爸爸妈妈的姓名和电话号码、家庭住址和学校名称: Remember your parents' names and phone numbers, your home address and the name of your school
不跟陌生人走，不吃陌生人给的食物和饮料，不坐陌生人的车: Do not go with strangers, accept food or drink from them or get into their cars
陌生人说“带你去找妈妈”“我给你好东西”，都要拒绝，并告诉大人: If a stranger says "I'll take you to your mum" or "I have something nice for you", refuse and tell an adult
走丢了，不要乱跑，留在原地，向穿制服的人（警察、保安、工作人员）求助，或者请店员: If you get lost, do not run around: stay where you are and ask someone in uniform (police, security, staff) for help, or ask a shop assistant to make an announcement or phone
遇到危险，大声喊“我不认识你”，往人多、亮的地方跑: In danger, shout loudly "I don't know you" and run to a place with many people and light
出门前告诉家人去哪里、和谁一起、几点回来: Before going out, tell your family where you are going, with whom and when you will be back
记住父母的电话和家庭地址: Remember your parents' phone number and your home address
电话地址要背熟，陌生人说话不理睬: Learn phone numbers and addresses by heart; ignore strangers who speak to you
个人卫生与七步洗手法: Personal hygiene and the seven-step handwashing method
饭前便后、外出回家、打喷嚏咳嗽后都要洗手: Wash your hands before meals, after the toilet, on returning home, and after sneezing or coughing
七步洗手法口诀“内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕”：洗手掌、洗手背、洗指缝、洗指背、洗: Seven-step mnemonic "palm, back, between, knuckles, thumb, tips, wrist" (内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕): wash palms, backs, between fingers, finger backs, thumbs, fingertips, wrists
用流动的水和肥皂（洗手液）洗，每一步至少搓15秒，全程不少于20秒: Wash with running water and soap (hand wash); rub at least 15 seconds per step and no less than 20 seconds in total
洗完用干净的毛巾或纸擦干: Dry with a clean towel or paper afterwards
早晚刷牙，饭后漱口，每次刷牙约3分钟: Brush your teeth morning and night, rinse your mouth after meals, and brush for about 3 minutes each time
勤剪指甲，勤洗澡，勤换衣服: Trim fingernails often, bathe often and change clothes often
咳嗽、打喷嚏时用纸巾或手肘遮住口鼻，不随地吐痰: When coughing or sneezing, cover your nose and mouth with a tissue or your elbow; do not spit on the ground
七步洗手法：内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕: Seven-step handwashing: palm, back, between, knuckles, thumb, tips, wrist (内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕)
饭前便后一定要洗手: Always wash your hands before meals and after the toilet
洗手用流动的水和肥皂，不少于20秒: Wash with running water and soap for no less than 20 seconds
内外夹弓大立腕，七步洗手最干净: Palm, back, between, knuckles, thumb, tips, wrist: seven steps for the cleanest hands (内外夹弓大立腕，七步洗手最干净)
读书写字姿势要端正：眼睛离书本约一尺（33厘米），胸口离桌子约一拳，握笔的手指离: Keep a correct posture for reading and writing: eyes about one chi (33 cm) from the book, chest about one fist from the desk, fingers about one cun from the pen tip
用眼20分钟后，向6米以外的远处看至少20秒，也叫“20-20-20”: After 20 minutes of eye use, look at something at least 6 metres away for at least 20 seconds, also called "20-20-20"
不在光线太暗或太强的地方看书；不躺着、趴着看书，不在走路和坐车时看书: Do not read in light that is too dim or too strong; do not read lying down or on your stomach, or while walking or in a vehicle
每天户外活动，可以让眼睛得到休息，有助于预防近视；每天户外活动时间累计约2小时: Outdoor activity every day lets the eyes rest and helps prevent short-sightedness; aim for about 2 hours outdoors in total each day
控制看电视、玩手机和平板的时间，连续使用不超过20分钟左右: Limit time on television, phones and tablets; do not use them for more than about 20 minutes at a stretch
做好眼保健操，不用脏手揉眼睛: Do the eye exercises properly and do not rub your eyes with dirty hands
定期检查视力，发现看不清要告诉家长，到正规医院验光: Have your eyesight checked regularly; if you cannot see clearly, tell your parents and have your eyes tested at a proper hospital
读书写字姿势要端正，做到一尺、一拳、一寸: Keep a correct reading and writing posture: one chi, one fist, one cun
用眼20分钟，远眺6米外至少20秒: After 20 minutes of eye use, look 6 metres away for at least 20 seconds
20分钟、20秒、6米远，户外活动保视力: 20 minutes, 20 seconds, 6 metres away; outdoor activity protects your eyes
我国生活垃圾一般分为四类：可回收物、厨余垃圾、有害垃圾、其他垃圾: Household waste in China is generally divided into four types: recyclable, kitchen, hazardous and other waste
可回收物（蓝色）：纸张、塑料瓶、金属、玻璃、旧衣物等: Recyclable waste (blue): paper, plastic bottles, metal, glass, old clothes, etc.
厨余垃圾（绿色）：剩饭剩菜、果皮、菜叶、骨头等: Kitchen waste (green): leftovers, fruit peel, vegetable leaves, bones, etc.
有害垃圾（红色）：电池、过期药品、荧光灯管、水银温度计等: Hazardous waste (red): batteries, expired medicines, fluorescent tubes, mercury thermometers, etc.
其他垃圾（灰色，有的地方为黑色）：纸巾、烟蒂、尘土、破碎陶瓷等: Other waste (grey, black in some places): tissues, cigarette ends, dust, broken ceramics, etc.
投放前把垃圾倒干净、压扁，不随地乱扔垃圾: Empty and flatten waste before disposal and do not litter
垃圾分类可以节约资源，减少污染，保护环境: Waste sorting saves resources, reduces pollution and protects the environment
生活垃圾分四类：可回收物、厨余垃圾、有害垃圾、其他垃圾: Household waste has four types: recyclable, kitchen, hazardous, other
对应的颜色：蓝、绿、红、灰: Matching colours: blue, green, red, grey
电池、过期药品是有害垃圾: Batteries and expired medicines are hazardous waste
蓝可回收，绿厨余，红有害，灰其他: Blue recyclable, green kitchen, red hazardous, grey other (蓝可回收，绿厨余，红有害，灰其他)
保护身体隐私：防性侵: Protecting body privacy: preventing sexual abuse
内衣内裤覆盖的地方，是我们身体的隐私部位，别人不能看、不能摸，也不能让别人拍照: The areas covered by underwear are our private body parts: others must not look at or touch them, or photograph them
任何人，包括熟人和亲戚，要碰你让你不舒服，都可以说“不”并马上离开: Anyone, including people you know and relatives, who touches you in a way that makes you uncomfortable: you may say "no" and leave at once
不跟别人玩要脱衣服、要保密的“游戏”；不要别人给的礼物、零食作为交换: Do not play "games" that involve undressing or keeping secrets; do not accept gifts or snacks in exchange
不单独跟异性成年人去偏僻、封闭的地方，不独自留在别人家: Do not go alone with an adult of the opposite sex to a remote or closed place, and do not stay alone in someone else's home
如果发生了让你害怕、不舒服的事，一定要尽快告诉信任的大人，如父母、老师: If something happens that frightens you or makes you uncomfortable, tell a trusted adult as soon as possible, such as a parent or teacher
遇到的事不是你的错，大人会保护你；还可以拨打110或12355寻求帮助: What happened is not your fault, and adults will protect you; you can also call 110 or 12355 for help
不要让别人看你的隐私部位，也不看、不传不文明的图片和视频: Do not let others see your private parts, and do not look at or share indecent pictures or videos
内衣内裤覆盖的地方，别人不能看，不能碰: The areas covered by underwear: others must not look or touch
不舒服就说“不”，马上离开: If uncomfortable, say "no" and leave at once
要告诉信任的大人，这不是你的错: Tell a trusted adult: it is not your fault
身体是自己的，不舒服就说“不”: The body is your own; if uncomfortable, say "no"
等电梯时按一次按钮就够了；先出后进，不抢、不挤: When waiting for a lift, pressing the button once is enough; let people out first, and do not rush or push
不在电梯里蹦跳、打闹，不扒电梯门，不用身体挡电梯门: Do not jump or fool around in the lift, do not pull at the lift doors or block them with your body
电梯发生故障被困：不要慌张，按警铃或用手机拨打电梯里的求助电话，等待救援: If trapped by a lift fault, do not panic: press the alarm bell or call the help number in the lift, and wait for rescue
不要扒门、爬出电梯，也不要乱按按钮: Do not pull at the doors or climb out of the lift, and do not press buttons at random
发生火灾、地震时不乘电梯: In a fire or earthquake, do not use the lift
低龄儿童乘电梯要有大人陪同；不要把手放在电梯门边: Young children must be accompanied by an adult in a lift; keep hands away from the door edge
手扶电梯上站稳，扶好扶手，不倚靠、不逆行，鞋带系紧、衣物不拖地: On an escalator, stand steady and hold the handrail, do not lean or go against the direction, tie shoelaces tightly and keep clothes off the floor
电梯里不蹦跳、不扒门: No jumping and no pulling at the doors in a lift
被困电梯按警铃求助，耐心等待，不爬出: If trapped, press the alarm bell, wait patiently and do not climb out
火灾、地震不乘电梯: No lift in a fire or earthquake
电梯门前不抢挤，被困时候别慌张: No rushing at lift doors; stay calm if trapped
公共场所防拥挤踩踏: Preventing crowd crushes in public places
在人多的地方（车站、商场、体育场、楼梯口）要靠右，按顺序走，不推挤，不奔跑: In crowded places (stations, shopping centres, stadiums, stair entrances) keep right, move in order and do not push or run
发现人群拥挤时，不逆着人流走，要顺着人流方向，尽快向边缘移动: If the crowd becomes dense, do not walk against it; go with its direction and move toward the edge as soon as possible
鞋子掉了不弯腰去捡，也不要弯腰系鞋带: If a shoe comes off, do not bend down to pick it up, or to tie a lace
如果被人群挤倒，要尽量缩成球状，双手护住头和颈部，贴墙边: If you are pushed over by the crowd, curl up into a ball as far as possible, protect your head and neck with both hands and stay close to a wall
听从工作人员和老师的指挥，不起哄、不制造恐慌: Follow the instructions of staff and teachers; do not stir things up or cause panic
和家人约好走散后见面的地点: Agree with your family on a meeting place in case you get separated
到人多的地方，尽量避开高峰时间: When going to crowded places, avoid peak times where possible
人群拥挤时顺着人流走，不逆行: In a dense crowd, go with the flow, not against it
不弯腰捡鞋、系鞋带: Do not bend down to pick up a shoe or tie a lace
摔倒后蜷缩身体，护住头颈: After a fall, curl up and protect head and neck
不推不挤靠右走，摔倒蜷身护头颈: No pushing, keep right; if you fall, curl up and protect head and neck
动物与蛇虫叮咬: Animals and insect or snake bites
不逗弄、不追打陌生的猫狗，不靠近正在吃东西的狗，不摸不熟悉的动物: Do not tease or chase unfamiliar cats and dogs, do not go near a dog that is eating, and do not touch animals you do not know
被猫狗咬伤、抓伤：马上用肥皂水和流动的清水冲洗伤口至少15分钟，并尽快到医院，按: If bitten or scratched by a cat or dog: wash the wound at once with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, go to hospital quickly, and follow the doctor's instructions on rabies prevention
被蜜蜂蜇：先看有没有留下刺，用干净的东西轻轻刮掉，冷敷；出现呼吸困难、面部肿胀要: Bee sting: check whether the sting is left in, scrape it off gently with something clean, apply a cold compress; if breathing is difficult or the face swells, call 120 at once
在野外穿长袖长裤、鞋袜，不用手伸进草丛、树洞、石缝: In the wild, wear long sleeves, trousers, shoes and socks, and do not put your hand into grass, tree holes or rock crevices
遇到蛇，不要惊慌，慢慢后退，不追打；被蛇咬后保持冷静，少活动，不要用嘴吸毒液，立: If you meet a snake, do not panic: back away slowly and do not chase or hit it; if bitten, stay calm, move as little as possible, do not suck out the venom and call 120 at once
蚊虫叮咬后不要抓破，涂止痒药膏；叮咬严重时去看医生: After an insect bite, do not scratch it open; apply anti-itch ointment; see a doctor if it is severe
家里有宠物要按时打疫苗，被宠物抓伤也要处理: Pets at home must be vaccinated on schedule, and scratches from pets must also be treated
被猫狗咬伤，先冲洗15分钟，再去医院: After a cat or dog bite, wash for 15 minutes first, then go to hospital
被蛇咬后保持冷静，少活动，拨打120: After a snake bite, stay calm, move as little as possible and call 120
动物不乱逗，被咬先冲洗再就医: Do not tease animals; if bitten, wash first and then see a doctor
上网安全的基本规则: Basic rules for safe internet use
不把姓名、学校、家庭住址、电话、照片和密码告诉网上认识的人: Do not give your name, school, home address, phone number, photos or passwords to people you meet online
密码要设置得复杂一些，不用生日和简单的数字；不告诉别人，不同网站不用同一个密码: Make passwords fairly complex, do not use birthdays or simple numbers, tell no one, and do not use the same password on different sites
不点击来历不明的链接，不扫陌生人给的二维码，不下载来路不明的软件: Do not click links of unknown origin, scan QR codes from strangers or download software of unknown origin
不单独去见网上认识的朋友: Never go alone to meet a friend you met online
上网、玩游戏要有时间限制，不沉迷；按规定的年龄和时间玩游戏: Set time limits for going online and playing games, and do not get addicted; play games only at the ages and times the rules allow
不在网上说脏话，不传谣言，不发别人的隐私: Do not use foul language online, spread rumours or post others' private information
遇到不舒服的内容或有人欺负你，先告诉家长或老师: If you meet content that makes you uncomfortable or someone bullies you, tell a parent or teacher first
不泄露个人信息和密码: Do not leak personal information and passwords
不点击陌生链接，不单独见网友: Do not click strange links; never meet online friends alone
遇到问题告诉家长或老师: If you meet a problem, tell a parent or teacher
网上交友要小心，个人信息不乱给: Be careful making friends online; do not give personal information freely
用水后随手关紧水龙头；刷牙、打肥皂时关水: Turn the tap off firmly after use; turn the water off while brushing teeth or soaping
一水多用：洗菜的水浇花，洗衣的水拖地、冲厕所: Use water more than once: water used for washing vegetables can water flowers, water from washing clothes can mop floors or flush toilets
夏天空调温度不要调得太低，26℃左右比较适宜: In summer, do not set the air conditioning too low; about 26 °C is suitable
人走关灯，不用的电器关掉，长期不用的拔掉插头: Switch off the light when you leave, turn off appliances not in use, and unplug those not used for a long time
使用节能灯、节水马桶等节能节水产品: Use energy-saving lamps, water-saving toilets and other energy- and water-saving products
我国的人均水资源量较少，节约用水人人有责；世界水日是3月22日: China has little water per person, so saving water is everyone's responsibility; World Water Day is 22 March
节约电、水和纸张，也是保护环境的做法: Saving electricity, water and paper is also a way of protecting the environment
随手关水龙头，人走关灯: Turn off taps firmly; switch off lights when you leave
节约资源，保护环境: Save resources and protect the environment
水龙头，随手关；灯，人走要关: Taps: turn off at once; lights: off when you leave (水龙头，随手关；灯，人走要关)
台风来临前：关紧门窗，加固阳台上的花盆、晾衣架；备好手电筒、食物、饮用水: Before a typhoon: close doors and windows firmly, secure flowerpots and clothes racks on the balcony, and prepare a torch, food and drinking water
台风天气尽量不外出，远离海边、河边、广告牌、大树、临时搭建物: In typhoon weather avoid going out; keep away from the coast, rivers, billboards, big trees and temporary structures
暴雨时不在低洼处、地下通道、桥下躲雨；已经有积水不要涉水，路面窨井盖可能被水冲开: In a rainstorm, do not shelter in low-lying places, underpasses or under bridges; do not wade through standing water, because manhole covers may have been washed open
山区遇暴雨，要警惕山洪和泥石流，不沿河谷行走，向两侧高处转移: In mountains, beware of flash floods and mudslides in a rainstorm; do not walk along valleys, and move to high ground on either side
车辆被水淹，要赶快离开车辆，向高处转移: If a vehicle is flooded, leave it quickly and move to high ground
雨后不立刻去河边、水边玩；不触碰落地电线和被水泡过的电器: After rain, do not go to rivers or waterside at once; do not touch fallen power lines or appliances that have been soaked
关注气象预警和学校的通知，听从安排: Pay attention to weather warnings and school notices and follow the arrangements
台风、暴雨预警分蓝黄橙红四级: Typhoon and rainstorm warnings have four levels: blue, yellow, orange, red
暴雨时不在低洼处和地下空间躲避: In a rainstorm, do not shelter in low-lying places or underground spaces
山洪来临往两侧高处转移: When a flash flood comes, move to high ground on either side
大风暴雨不外出，低洼地下要躲开: In strong wind and rain do not go out; avoid low-lying and underground places
雷雨时尽量待在室内，关好门窗: In a thunderstorm stay indoors as far as possible, with doors and windows closed
不在大树下、旗杆旁、孤立的建筑物下躲雨，不在空旷的地方站立或奔跑: Do not shelter under big trees, beside flagpoles or under isolated buildings, and do not stand or run in open areas
雷雨天不洗澡淋浴、不接触金属水管，不使用有线电话: In a thunderstorm do not take a bath or shower, touch metal water pipes or use a corded telephone
不在水边、水池里游泳、钓鱼；远离金属栏杆、电线: Do not swim or fish in water or pools; keep away from metal railings and power lines
户外遇雷电，双脚并拢蹲下，身体向前弯，不躺在地上，尽快进入车内或建筑物: If caught outdoors by lightning, crouch with feet together and bend forward; do not lie on the ground; get into a car or building as soon as possible
雷电预警分黄色、橙色、红色三级: Lightning warnings have three levels: yellow, orange, red
看到闪电后数到听到雷声的秒数，越短说明雷电越近: After seeing lightning, count the seconds until you hear thunder; the shorter, the closer the lightning
雷雨时不在大树下躲雨: In a thunderstorm do not shelter under big trees
雷雨时远离水边和金属物体: In a thunderstorm keep away from water and metal objects
雷雨不躲大树下，水边金属要远离: In thunderstorms do not shelter under trees; keep away from water and metal
高温预警分黄色、橙色、红色三级；黄色预警一般是未来24小时内最高气温将升到35℃: Heat warnings have three levels: yellow, orange, red; a yellow warning generally means the highest temperature will reach 35 °C or above within the next 24 hours
高温天尽量避开中午最热的时间外出，戴帽子、涂防晒、多喝水: In hot weather avoid going out at the hottest time around noon; wear a hat, use sunscreen and drink plenty of water
中暑的表现：头晕、头痛、恶心、大量出汗；要立刻转移到阴凉通风处，补充淡盐水，严重: Signs of heatstroke: dizziness, headache, nausea, heavy sweating; move at once to a cool, ventilated place, take light salt water, and call 120 if severe
绝对不能把孩子独自留在密闭的车里: Never leave a child alone in a closed car
寒潮预警分蓝色、黄色、橙色、红色四级: Cold-wave warnings have four levels: blue, yellow, orange, red
寒潮来临要加衣保暖，注意手脚、耳朵防冻，使用取暖设备时要通风，防止一氧化碳中毒: When a cold wave arrives, wear more clothes, protect hands, feet and ears from frost, and ventilate when using heating to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning
冰雪路面要放慢速度，慢步走，避免跑跳: On icy or snowy roads, slow down, walk slowly and avoid running and jumping
高温时多喝水，避开正午外出: In hot weather drink plenty of water and avoid going out at noon
中暑要转移到阴凉处并补水: For heatstroke, move to a cool place and rehydrate
不把孩子独自留在密闭的车内: Never leave a child alone in a closed car
热天避正午，多喝水，中暑要降温: In hot weather avoid noon, drink plenty of water, and cool down for heatstroke
驾驶电动自行车须年满16周岁；未满16周岁不得驾驶电动自行车上路: One must be 16 to ride an electric bicycle; under 16, do not ride one on the road
骑电动自行车要戴头盔（许多地方规定必须戴），不带超过规定的人，不超速，不逆行: Wear a helmet on an electric bicycle (many places require it), do not carry more than the permitted number of people, speed or go against traffic
不闯红灯，不在机动车道行驶；转弯前先观察并示意: Do not run red lights or ride in motor vehicle lanes; observe and signal before turning
电动自行车不在楼道、电梯里充电，不私自改装电池和车速: Do not charge electric bicycles in stairwells or lifts, and do not modify the battery or speed without authorisation
乘坐摩托车和电动自行车时同样要戴头盔: Wear a helmet in the same way when riding on a motorcycle or electric bicycle as a passenger
发生交通事故，先保护好自己，拨打122报警，有人受伤拨打120: After a traffic accident, protect yourself first, call 122 to report it, and call 120 if someone is hurt
骑行时不戴耳机、不看手机、不打电话: When riding, do not wear headphones, look at a phone or make calls
驾驶电动自行车须年满16周岁: One must be 16 to ride an electric bicycle
不在楼道和电梯里给电动车充电: Do not charge e-bikes in stairwells and lifts
年满十六才可骑，头盔不戴不上路: Sixteen to ride; no helmet, no riding (年满十六才可骑，头盔不戴不上路)
进入实验室，听从老师的安排；没有老师允许，不动仪器和药品: In the laboratory follow the teacher's instructions; do not touch instruments or chemicals without the teacher's permission
实验前预习步骤，了解药品性质；实验时戴好护目镜，必要时戴手套，长发要束起: Before an experiment, read through the steps and learn the properties of the chemicals; wear goggles, gloves if necessary, and tie back long hair
不用手直接拿药品，不尝药品的味道，闻气味时用手轻轻扇动，让少量气体飘向鼻孔: Do not pick up chemicals with your hands or taste them; to smell, waft a little gas gently toward your nose with your hand
用酒精灯时：用火柴点燃，不用燃着的酒精灯去引燃另一盏，不向燃着的灯里添加酒精；熄: With an alcohol burner: light it with a match, never use a burning one to light another, never add alcohol to a burning one; put it out with the cap, never by blowing
给试管里的液体加热，试管口不能对着自己和别人，试管里的液体不超过试管容积的三分之: When heating liquid in a test tube, never point the mouth of the tube at yourself or others; the liquid must not exceed one third of the tube's volume
稀释浓硫酸要把浓硫酸沿着器壁慢慢倒入水中，并不断搅拌，不能把水倒进浓硫酸里: To dilute concentrated sulphuric acid, pour the acid slowly into water along the wall of the vessel, stirring continuously; never pour water into concentrated sulphuric acid
实验后废液、废物按老师要求倒入指定容器，不倒进水池；离开前洗手，整理好桌面: After the experiment, pour waste liquid and waste into the designated containers as the teacher requires, not down the sink; wash your hands and tidy the bench before leaving
稀释浓硫酸：酸入水，沿器壁慢慢倒，不断搅拌: Diluting concentrated sulphuric acid: acid into water, pour slowly along the wall, stir continuously
酒精灯用灯帽盖灭，不能用嘴吹: Put out an alcohol burner with the cap; never blow it out
不尝药品，不用手直接拿药品: Do not taste chemicals or pick them up with your hands
酸入水，不吹灯，药品不尝不乱碰: Acid into water, never blow out the flame, never taste or carelessly touch chemicals (酸入水，不吹灯，药品不尝不乱碰)
防电信网络诈骗与游戏充值: Preventing telecom and online fraud, and game top-up scams
不轻信“冒充公检法”“冒充客服退款”“网络刷单”“中奖”等电话和信息: Do not readily believe calls and messages claiming to be "police, procuratorate or court", "customer service refunds", "online order-brushing jobs" or "prizes"
任何人要求转账、提供验证码、银行卡密码，都不要给；先问家长: If anyone asks you to transfer money or give a verification code or bank card password, do not give it; ask a parent first

可以安装并使用国家反诈中心提供的软件，拨打反诈专线96110了解情况: You can install and use the software provided by the National Anti-Fraud Center, and call the anti-fraud line 96110 to learn more

验证码、银行卡密码不告诉任何人: Tell no one verification codes or bank card passwords
不擅自给游戏充值: Do not top up games without permission
被骗要立刻告诉家长并报警110: If cheated, tell a parent at once and report to 110
不给密码验证码，转账先问爸妈: No passwords or codes; ask Mum and Dad before any transfer
欺凌是故意、反复地伤害别人，包括打骂、辱骂、排挤、起外号、在网络上嘲笑别人: Bullying is deliberately and repeatedly hurting others, including hitting, verbal abuse, exclusion, nicknaming and mocking others online
自己不欺负别人，也不跟着起哄；看到别人被欺负，可以劝阻，并告诉老师: Do not bully others and do not join in; if you see someone being bullied, you can try to stop it and tell a teacher
被欺负时，要保持冷静，尽量走到人多的地方，大声表达“请停下”，并尽快告诉老师和家: If bullied, stay calm, go to a place with many people if you can, say loudly "please stop", and tell a teacher and your parents as soon as possible
把被欺负的经过、时间、地点、人物记下来，保存聊天记录、截图等证据: Write down what happened, when, where and who was involved, and keep chat records, screenshots and other evidence
欺负别人是不对的，不是自己的错；被欺负的人没有错: Bullying others is wrong; being bullied is not your fault; the person bullied is not at fault
情节严重的欺凌，可以由学校、家长报警，拨打110: In serious cases the school or parents can report it by calling 110
可以拨打12355青少年服务热线求助: You can call the 12355 youth service hotline for help
被欺负时，告诉老师和家长: If bullied, tell a teacher and your parents
自己不欺负别人，不起哄: Do not bully others and do not join in
保存证据，必要时报警110: Keep evidence and report to 110 if necessary
不欺人，不起哄，被欺负要说出: Do not bully, do not join in; if bullied, speak up
心理健康与向信任的大人求助: Mental health and asking trusted adults for help
每个人都会有高兴、生气、害怕、难过的时候，这些感受都很正常: Everyone sometimes feels happy, angry, afraid or sad; these feelings are all normal
心情不好时，可以找信任的人聊聊：父母、老师、学校的心理老师: When in a bad mood, talk to someone you trust: parents, teachers or the school counsellor
运动、听音乐、画画、深呼吸、写日记，都是调节情绪的好办法: Exercise, music, drawing, deep breathing and keeping a diary are good ways to regulate emotions
考试压力大、跟同学吵架、家里发生变化，都是需要说出来的事，不用独自承受: Exam stress, quarrels with classmates and changes at home are things to talk about; you do not have to bear them alone
如果长时间情绪低落、睡不着、总有伤害自己的想法，要尽快告诉家长和老师，并到正规医: If you feel low for a long time, cannot sleep or often think of harming yourself, tell your parents and teachers as soon as possible and see the psychology department of a proper hospital
可以拨打全国青少年服务热线12355获得帮助；危急时拨打110或120: You can call the national youth service hotline 12355 for help; in an emergency call 110 or 120
朋友情绪不好时，要认真倾听，并鼓励他告诉大人，不替他保密: When a friend is feeling bad, listen carefully and encourage them to tell an adult; do not keep it secret for them
心情不好要找信任的大人说: When in a bad mood, talk to a trusted adult
长期情绪低落要尽快告诉家长和老师，寻求专业帮助: If you feel low for a long time, tell parents and teachers soon and seek professional help
心里有事说出来，大人能帮你: Say what is on your mind; adults can help you
烟酒与毒品的危害: The harm of tobacco, alcohol and drugs
吸烟有害健康，二手烟对身边的人也有伤害；法律规定禁止向未成年人出售烟酒: Smoking harms health, and second-hand smoke also harms those nearby; the law forbids selling tobacco and alcohol to minors
未成年人身体还在发育，喝酒会伤害大脑和肝脏；不喝酒，不吸烟，包括电子烟: Minors' bodies are still developing and alcohol harms the brain and liver; do not drink or smoke, including e-cigarettes
毒品包括海洛因、冰毒、K粉等；吸毒会损害身体，使人上瘾，影响家庭和未来: Drugs include heroin, methamphetamine, ketamine and others; drug use damages the body, causes addiction and affects family and future
不接受陌生人和朋友递来的香烟、饮料、“药丸”，不去夜店等不适合的场所: Do not accept cigarettes, drinks or "pills" offered by strangers or friends, and do not go to unsuitable places such as nightclubs
毒品第一次也不能尝；发现有人吸毒、贩毒，不要自己去处理，要告诉家长、老师，拨打1: Never try drugs even once; if you find someone using or selling drugs, do not deal with it yourself: tell parents and teachers and call 110
吸烟、喝酒、吸毒并不表示“成熟”，敢于拒绝才是勇敢: Smoking, drinking and drug use do not mean being "mature"; daring to refuse is what is brave
6月26日是国际禁毒日: 26 June is the International Day against Drug Abuse
不吸烟，不喝酒，远离毒品: Do not smoke, do not drink, stay away from drugs
发现毒品相关的事，告诉大人并拨打110: If you learn of anything drug-related, tell an adult and call 110
烟酒不沾，毒品不碰，拒绝要勇敢: No tobacco or alcohol, no drugs; be brave enough to refuse
只在有救生员、有安全设施的正规游泳场所游泳，并且要有家长陪同: Swim only at proper venues with lifeguards and safety facilities, and always with a parent present
游泳前做热身运动；不在饭后马上游，也不空着肚子游，不在身体不适时游泳: Warm up before swimming; do not swim straight after a meal or on an empty stomach, or when unwell
不在浅水区跳水；不在水里互相推按、打闹: Do not dive in shallow water; do not push or fool around in the water
游泳时腿抽筋：保持冷静，吸一口气仰卧，用力伸直抽筋的腿，大声呼救: If you get cramp in a leg while swimming: stay calm, take a breath, float on your back, straighten the cramped leg firmly and call loudly for help
遇到危险时，不要慌张，放松身体，仰起头呼吸，大声呼救: In danger, do not panic: relax your body, tilt your head back to breathe and call loudly for help
乘船、划船要穿救生衣，不在船上打闹，不超载: Wear a life jacket when going by boat or rowing, do not fool around on the boat and do not overload it
遇到有人溺水，先呼救并拨打120、110，利用救生圈、木棍等救人，不盲目下水: If someone is drowning, call for help first and call 120 and 110; use a lifebuoy, stick or similar to rescue them, and do not jump in blindly
在正规场所、有家长陪同下游泳: Swim at proper venues with a parent present
腿抽筋时保持冷静，仰卧伸直，呼救: With a cramp, stay calm, float on your back, straighten the leg and call for help
救人要先呼救，不盲目下水: To rescue someone, call for help first and do not jump in blindly
热身再下水，遇险不慌张，救人先呼救: Warm up before entering the water, stay calm in danger, call for help before rescuing
出行前告诉家人去哪里、和谁一起、几点回来；野外活动要结伴并有成年人带领: Before going out, tell your family where you are going, with whom and when you will be back; go in a group led by an adult for outdoor activities
带够水、食物、雨具、药品，穿合适的鞋子和衣服: Take enough water, food, rain gear and medicine, and wear suitable shoes and clothes
不喝不干净的生水，不吃不认识的野果野菜: Do not drink unclean untreated water or eat wild fruit or vegetables you do not recognise
迷路时不要乱走，留在原地，使用手机、哨子求救，拨打110或120: If lost, do not wander: stay where you are, call for help with a phone or whistle, and call 110 or 120
不攀爬陡峭的山崖，不靠近悬崖边、水边，不在河边的石头上玩: Do not climb steep cliffs, go near cliff edges or water, or play on rocks by a river
夏季山区有山洪、雷电，注意天气变化，遇到危险及时撤离: In summer, mountains have flash floods and lightning; watch the weather and withdraw in time if in danger
旅行时保管好证件、钱物，不随便跟陌生人走，住宿要看清安全出口: When travelling, keep your documents, money and belongings safe, do not go with strangers, and check the safety exits where you stay
野外活动要结伴，并有成年人带领: For outdoor activities go in a group, led by an adult
迷路时留在原地求救: If lost, stay where you are and call for help
不吃不认识的野果野菜: Do not eat wild fruit or vegetables you do not recognise
出门告知行程，结伴同行，迷路原地求救: Tell people your plans, go in a group, and if lost stay put and call for help
传染病是由病毒、细菌等引起的，通过空气、飞沫、接触、食物、蚊虫等传播: Infectious diseases are caused by viruses, bacteria and so on, and spread through air, droplets, contact, food, insects and other routes
常见的有流感、水痘、手足口病、诺如病毒感染、结核病等: Common ones include influenza, chickenpox, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, norovirus infection and tuberculosis
勤洗手，戴口罩（在人多或有症状时），勤开窗通风，不随地吐痰: Wash your hands often, wear a mask (in crowds or when you have symptoms), open windows often to ventilate, and do not spit on the ground
按计划接种疫苗，是预防传染病最有效的方法之一: Vaccination on schedule is one of the most effective ways to prevent infectious diseases
出现发热、咳嗽、呕吐、皮疹等症状，要告诉家长和老师，到医院就诊，在家休息，不带病: If you have fever, cough, vomiting, a rash or similar symptoms, tell your parents and teachers, see a doctor, rest at home and do not go to school ill
和患病的人保持距离，不共用毛巾、水杯和餐具: Keep a distance from people who are ill and do not share towels, cups or tableware
不吃不干净的食物，不喝生水，防止蚊虫叮咬，清除积水: Do not eat unclean food or drink untreated water, prevent mosquito bites and clear standing water
传染病的防控措施包括控制传染源、切断传播途径、保护易感人群: Control measures for infectious diseases include controlling the source of infection, cutting off transmission routes and protecting susceptible people
传染病防控：控制传染源、切断传播途径、保护易感人群: Infectious disease control: control the source, cut off routes, protect the susceptible
勤洗手、通风、接种疫苗: Wash hands often, ventilate, get vaccinated
生病时在家休息，不带病上学: When ill, rest at home; do not go to school sick
传染源、途径、易感者，三个环节要记牢: Remember the three links: source, route, susceptible people
睡眠要充足：小学生每天约10小时，初中生每天约9小时（高中生约8小时）: Get enough sleep: primary pupils about 10 hours a day, junior-high students about 9 hours (senior-high about 8 hours)
按时睡觉、按时起床，睡前不玩手机和平板，晚上不喝含咖啡因的饮料: Go to bed and get up on time, do not use phones or tablets before bed, and do not drink caffeinated drinks in the evening
每天要进行不少于1小时的体育活动，其中包括跑跳、球类等有一定强度的运动: Do at least 1 hour of physical activity every day, including running, jumping, ball games and other moderately intense exercise
运动前热身，运动后拉伸；不在刚吃完饭后剧烈运动: Warm up before exercise and stretch afterwards; do not exercise vigorously straight after a meal
运动时要穿合适的鞋子，选择安全的场地；天太热或太冷时调整运动量: Wear suitable shoes and choose a safe place to exercise; adjust the amount of exercise in very hot or cold weather
运动中头晕、胸闷、疼痛要马上停下并休息，告诉老师或大人: If you feel dizzy, tight in the chest or pain during exercise, stop and rest at once and tell a teacher or adult
均衡饮食，早餐吃好，多喝水，少吃零食和含糖饮料: Eat a balanced diet, have a good breakfast, drink plenty of water, and eat fewer snacks and sugary drinks
小学生每天睡约10小时，初中生约9小时: Primary pupils sleep about 10 hours a day, junior-high students about 9
每天不少于1小时体育活动: At least 1 hour of physical activity every day
运动前热身，不舒服马上停下: Warm up before exercise; stop at once if you feel unwell
早睡早起，天天运动，一小时的活动不能少: Early to bed, early to rise, exercise daily, never skip the hour of activity (早睡早起，天天运动，一小时的活动不能少)
生病要看医生，药要按医嘱吃，不自己随便吃药，不吃别人的药: See a doctor when ill and take medicine as prescribed; do not take medicine on your own or other people's medicine
吃药前看清药名、用量、用法和有效期；不吃过期的药: Before taking medicine check its name, dose, method and expiry date; do not take expired medicine
药品要放在儿童拿不到的地方，不把药当糖果吃: Keep medicines where children cannot reach them; do not eat medicine like sweets
不能认为“多吃就好得快”，不能自己增加药量: Do not think "more medicine means faster recovery" and do not increase the dose yourself
出现皮疹、呼吸困难、呕吐等不良反应，要立即停药并告诉大人，必要时拨打120: If a rash, difficulty breathing, vomiting or other adverse reactions appear, stop the medicine at once, tell an adult and call 120 if necessary
对某些药物或食物过敏的人，就医时要告诉医生: People who are allergic to certain drugs or foods should tell the doctor when seeking treatment

遵医嘱用药，不随便吃药: Take medicine as the doctor says; do not take medicine at random
看清药名、用量和有效期: Check the name, dose and expiry date
药品放在儿童拿不到的地方: Keep medicines where children cannot reach them
看医生，遵医嘱，药不乱吃不多吃: See a doctor, follow the prescription; no random medicine, no excess (看医生，遵医嘱，药不乱吃不多吃)
紧急电话与怎样求助: Emergency numbers and how to ask for help
报警电话110：遇到坏人、被抢、被欺负、走失、有人受伤: Police 110: when you meet bad people, are robbed, bullied or lost, or someone is hurt
火警电话119：发生火灾、爆炸、被困等: Fire 119: fire, explosion, being trapped and so on
急救电话120：有人生病、受伤、昏倒、溺水、中毒等: Ambulance 120: someone is ill, hurt, unconscious, drowning, poisoned and so on
交通事故电话122：发生交通事故: Traffic accidents 122: when a traffic accident occurs
全国青少年服务热线12355：遇到烦恼、被欺负，可以求助: National youth service hotline 12355: when you are troubled or bullied, you can ask for help
政务服务便民热线12345：反映社会和公共服务方面的问题: Government service hotline 12345: to report problems with society and public services
打电话时先说清地址（路名、小区、门牌）、发生了什么事、有几个人、自己的名字和电话: When calling, first state the address (road, residential area, door number), what has happened, how many people are involved, and your own name and phone number; follow the operator's instructions and do not hang up first
这些电话都是免费的，不能随便拨着玩，谎报警情是违法的: These numbers are free; never dial them for fun, and giving a false alarm is illegal
打电话要说清地址、发生了什么事: When calling, state the address and what happened
不乱拨紧急电话: Do not dial emergency numbers at random
一一零警，一一九火，一二零医: One-one-zero police, one-one-nine fire, one-two-zero doctor (一一零警，一一九火，一二零医)
先确保自己和伤病者所处的环境安全，再救助；自己不安全时不要贸然施救: First make sure the surroundings are safe for you and the casualty, then help; if you are not safe, do not rush in to rescue
判断是否有意识：轻拍肩膀，大声呼喊“你怎么了？”: Check for consciousness: tap the shoulders gently and call out loudly "What is wrong?"
立即拨打120（或让别人拨打），说清地址、人数、情况，并保持电话畅通: Call 120 at once (or have someone else call), give the address, number of people and situation, and keep the line open
不要随意搬动伤者，特别是怀疑颈部或背部受伤时: Do not move the casualty unnecessarily, especially if a neck or back injury is suspected
在救护车到达前，按学过的方法进行止血、包扎、心肺复苏等: Before the ambulance arrives, use the methods you have learned, such as stopping bleeding, bandaging and cardiopulmonary resuscitation
有人昏倒，让他平躺，松开衣领，保持呼吸道通畅: If someone faints, lay them flat, loosen the collar and keep the airway open
小学生遇到急救情况，要先找成年人帮忙并拨打120，不要冒险施救: Primary pupils facing a first-aid situation should first find an adult and call 120, and not take risks
先保证安全，再拨打120: Make sure of safety first, then call 120
不确定怎么救时，不随意搬动伤者: If unsure how to help, do not move the casualty unnecessarily
找大人帮助，说清地址和情况: Get an adult to help; state the address and situation clearly
先安全，再呼救；找大人，打120: Safety first, then call for help; find an adult, call 120
发现有人突然倒地：先确认环境安全，拍肩呼喊，看有没有反应、有没有正常呼吸: If someone suddenly collapses: first confirm the surroundings are safe, tap the shoulders and call out, and check for any response and for normal breathing
没有反应、没有呼吸或只有喘息：立刻大声呼救，让人拨打120，并取来自动体外除颤器: No response, no breathing or only gasping: call loudly for help at once, have someone call 120 and fetch an automated external defibrillator (AED)
胸外按压：两手掌根重叠，放在两乳头连线的中点，手臂伸直，向下用力按压: Chest compressions: place the heels of both hands one on top of the other at the midpoint of the line between the nipples, keep arms straight and press down firmly
按压的深度约5—6厘米（成人），速度每分钟100—120次，每次让胸廓完全回弹: Compression depth about 5-6 cm (adults), rate 100-120 per minute, letting the chest recoil fully each time
按压30次，吹气2次，按30:2的比例循环；不会人工呼吸时可以只做胸外按压: 30 compressions, 2 breaths, repeated in a 30:2 ratio; if you cannot do rescue breaths, chest compressions alone are enough
AED取来后，打开电源，按语音提示贴好电极片并操作；救护车到来或伤者恢复呼吸前不: When the AED arrives, switch it on, attach the pads and follow the voice prompts; do not stop until the ambulance arrives or the casualty starts breathing
这是学校急救课的内容；不要在没有人需要救助时乱练，应在老师或专业人员指导下用模型: This is school first-aid course content; do not practise at random when nobody needs help, but practise on a model under the guidance of a teacher or professional
按压与吹气的比例是30:2: The ratio of compressions to breaths is 30:2
先呼救120，并取AED: First call 120 for help and fetch the AED
三十比二，一百到一百二: Thirty to two, a hundred to a hundred and twenty (三十比二，一百到一百二)
小伤口：先用干净的流动清水冲洗，再用消毒的创可贴或纱布覆盖: Small wound: rinse with clean running water first, then cover with a sterile plaster or gauze
流血较多：用干净的纱布或毛巾直接按压伤口，一直压住，不要松开去看: Heavy bleeding: press directly on the wound with clean gauze or a towel, keep pressing and do not let go to look
把受伤的手或脚抬高，高于心脏的位置，帮助止血: Raise the injured hand or foot above the level of the heart to help stop bleeding
包扎要松紧适度，手指、脚趾要露在外面观察颜色: Bandage with moderate tightness, leaving fingers and toes exposed so their colour can be seen
不要用脏布、泥土、药粉直接涂抹伤口: Do not apply dirty cloth, soil or powder directly to a wound
流鼻血：坐着，身体稍向前倾，用手捏住鼻翼两侧约10分钟，不要仰头: Nosebleed: sit with the body leaning slightly forward and pinch both sides of the nose for about 10 minutes; do not tilt the head back
血止不住、伤口很深或被生锈的东西扎伤，要立即就医，必要时拨打120: If bleeding will not stop, the wound is deep or the injury was caused by something rusty, seek medical care at once and call 120 if necessary
流血时用干净的布直接按压止血: When bleeding, press directly with a clean cloth to stop it
伤口先用清水冲洗: Rinse a wound with clean water first
流鼻血不要仰头: With a nosebleed do not tilt the head back
清水冲，压住血，抬高肢，及时医: Rinse with clean water, press to stop bleeding, raise the limb, see a doctor promptly (清水冲，压住血，抬高肢，及时医)
烫伤的处理：冲、脱、泡、盖、送: Treating burns: cool, remove, soak, cover, send
冲：立即用流动的凉水冲洗烫伤的部位，约15—30分钟: Cool: immediately rinse the burnt area with running cool water for about 15-30 minutes
脱：在冷水中小心地脱去或剪开衣物，不要强行撕扯: Remove: carefully take off or cut away clothing under cold water; do not tear it off by force
泡：继续把伤处放在冷水里浸泡，减轻疼痛: Soak: keep the injured area in cold water to ease the pain
盖：用干净的纱布或毛巾轻轻盖住伤处: Cover: cover the injured area gently with clean gauze or a towel
送：面积较大、水泡较多或在脸部、手部、关节时，要及时送医院: Send: if the area is large, there are many blisters, or the burn is on the face, hands or joints, take the person to hospital promptly
不涂牙膏、酱油、牙粉，不挑破水泡，不用冰块直接敷: Do not apply toothpaste, soy sauce or tooth powder, do not burst blisters and do not apply ice directly
预防烫伤：热水、热汤放在孩子够不到的地方，倒热水时不跑、不闹: To prevent burns, keep hot water and soup out of children's reach, and do not run or fool around when pouring hot water
烫伤口诀：冲、脱、泡、盖、送: Burns mnemonic: cool, remove, soak, cover, send (冲、脱、泡、盖、送)
冲脱泡盖送，五步不能少: Cool, remove, soak, cover, send: do not skip any of the five steps (冲脱泡盖送，五步不能少)
怀疑骨折：不要乱动受伤的部位，尽量保持原来的姿势，也不要揉、按: If a fracture is suspected, do not move the injured part; keep it in its original position as far as possible and do not rub or press it
用木板、硬纸板、树枝等把受伤处固定好，包括骨折处上下两个关节: Immobilise the injury with a board, cardboard, branches or similar, including the joints above and below the fracture
有伤口出血，先止血再固定；不把外露的骨头推回去: If there is a bleeding wound, stop the bleeding first and then immobilise; do not push exposed bone back in
尽快拨打120，或在大人陪同下去医院: Call 120 as soon as possible, or go to hospital accompanied by an adult
扭伤：停止运动，抬高伤处，冷敷（不要立刻热敷、揉搓），可以用弹力绷带包扎: Sprain: stop exercising, raise the injured area and apply cold (not heat or rubbing straight away); an elastic bandage may be used
颈部、背部受伤，不要随意搬动: With a neck or back injury, do not move the person unnecessarily
运动前热身，穿合适的运动鞋，可以预防扭伤: Warming up before exercise and wearing suitable sports shoes can prevent sprains
怀疑骨折不乱动，固定后送医院: With a suspected fracture, do not move; immobilise and go to hospital
扭伤先冷敷，不揉搓: For a sprain, apply cold first and do not rub
颈部背部受伤不搬动: Do not move a neck or back injury
骨折先固定，扭伤先冷敷: Fracture: immobilise first; sprain: cold first
进食时说话、大笑、跑跳，容易把食物呛进气管，造成噎住: Talking, laughing, running or jumping while eating makes it easy to breathe food into the windpipe and choke
噎住的表现：不能说话，不能咳嗽，用手捂住喉咙，脸色发紫: Signs of choking: unable to speak or cough, hands clasped to the throat, face turning blue
一岁以上的儿童和成人：站在伤者身后，一手握拳，拳眼放在肚脐上方，另一手抱住，快速: Children over one year and adults: stand behind the person, make a fist with one hand and place it above the navel, hold it with the other hand and thrust quickly inward and upward until the object comes out
婴儿的方法不同（拍背和按压胸部），应在专业人员指导下学习: The method for infants is different (back blows and chest compressions) and should be learned under professional guidance
同时让人拨打120；如果伤者昏倒，要进行心肺复苏: At the same time have someone call 120; if the person collapses, perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation
自己噎住时，可以把上腹部靠在椅背或桌边，用力冲击: If you are choking yourself, press your upper abdomen against a chair back or table edge and thrust hard
预防：吃东西细嚼慢咽，不边吃边玩，不给小孩吃整颗的果冻、坚果: Prevention: chew food well and eat slowly, do not play while eating, and do not give small children whole jellies or nuts
吃东西时不说笑、不打闹: Do not talk, laugh or fool around while eating
噎住时用海姆立克急救法，并拨打120: If choking, use the Heimlich manoeuvre and call 120
婴儿的急救方法不同: First aid for infants is different
吃饭不说笑，噎住急救快: No talking or laughing at meals; if choking, act fast (吃饭不说笑，噎住急救快)
发现有人溺水，先大声呼救，拨打120和110，不要盲目下水: If you see someone drowning, call out loudly for help, call 120 and 110 and do not jump in blindly
可以用救生圈、木板、绳子、长竿等把落水的人拉上来: Use a lifebuoy, board, rope, long pole or similar to pull the person out of the water
把溺水者救上岸后，让他平卧，清除口鼻中的异物: After bringing the person ashore, lay them flat and clear any foreign matter from the mouth and nose
检查有没有意识和呼吸；没有呼吸，要马上开始心肺复苏，直到救护车到达: Check for consciousness and breathing; if there is no breathing, start cardiopulmonary resuscitation at once and continue until the ambulance arrives
不要让溺水的人头朝下，不要用“倒挂”“压肚子”的方法控水，这样会耽误抢救: Do not hold the person head-down or use "hanging upside down" or "pressing the belly" methods to drain water: they delay rescue
给溺水者保暖，换掉湿衣服: Keep the person warm and change out of wet clothes
即使溺水者醒来，也要到医院检查，因为可能出现肺部的问题: Even if the person wakes up, they must be checked at hospital because lung problems may follow
溺水时先呼救，不盲目下水: If someone is drowning, call for help first; do not jump in blindly
救上岸后没有呼吸要做心肺复苏: If there is no breathing after rescue, do CPR
不倒挂控水，要送医院检查: Do not hang the person upside down to drain water; take them to hospital for checks
溺水先呼救，上岸再急救，医院要检查: Drowning: call for help first, give first aid ashore, and have a hospital check
